meta.title: A vendor cannot read another vendor's response
gaps: There is no operation or library case for GET /template_responses/:B_uuid, so the decisive cross-vendor response-read refusal cannot be checked.
The available technical-response operation only starts vendor B's response; it cannot submit or read the response.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFP + RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted its technical response; rounds still open.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live technical round.
A second QA vendor starts a technical response on the RFP round.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
